messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "store in the refrigerator or at room temperature up to 86°F (30°C)"
set: ["store in the refrigerator or at room temperature up to 86°F (30°C)", "may be kept at room temperature up to 86°F (30°C)", "store made-up suspension at room temperature", "after first use, store the pen with the needle removed in a refrigerator or at room temperature", "controlled room temperature is 59°F to 86°F (15°C to 30°C)", "store at room temperature away from moisture and heat", "store at room temperature between 68°F and 77°F (20°C to 25°C)", "store between 59°F to 86°F (15°C to 30°C) or in refrigerator for up to 56 days after first use", "store at room temperature away from moisture, heat, or cold temperatures", "may be kept at room temperature for up to 21 days", "liquid amoxicillin may need to be stored in a refrigerator or at room temperature depending on the brand", "may be kept at room temperature", "store the oral liquid at room temperature and keep it in a tightly closed bottle", "store tightly closed at room temperature away from moisture and heat", "once at room temperature, do not return to refrigerator", "store tablets and capsules at room temperature away from moisture and heat"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
